'''Chris Feher''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 East Lansing tournament]] on 13 February 2001 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]], according to Andrew Ehret's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1730">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-13-east-lansing-michigan-feb-132001d1730/ east-lansing-michigan-feb-132001], DeckTech (Andrew "Gwaihir" Ehret, 13 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-13-east-lansing-michigan-feb-132001d1730/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
